class.name: StairsWalkGrid
class.brief_description: A level's static boxes, indexed so [StairsBody] nodes can walk on them without physics queries.
class.description: Give it to a [StairsBody] as [member StairsBody.walk_grid], and while the body walks on what it baked, its moves make no physics queries: it moves over the boxes analytically, the way crowds in shipped games walk on baked navigation data and use physics only when they must. Bakes the [StaticBody3D] nodes under its parent, or under itself when it has none. Boxes turned only about the vertical, at any scale, on a layer in [member collision_mask], are baked. Every other static shape there is kept as a region the grid does not answer for, and a body that collides with it sweeps near it: other shapes, boxes tilted off the vertical, bodies on layers outside the mask, and conveyors (a nonzero [member StaticBody3D.constant_linear_velocity] or [member StaticBody3D.constant_angular_velocity]). A level whose ground is one trimesh or [WorldBoundaryShape3D] is therefore walked by sweeps throughout. [AnimatableBody3D] and other bodies that move are not baked, and a body walking on the grid does not see them. It bakes the first time a body uses it; call [method bake] while the level loads to keep that cost off a frame. The index does not follow changes to the level: after adding, removing or moving static geometry, call [method bake] again. A level too large to index, past 16 million 2 m bins, bakes nothing and says so, and bodies sweep. Main thread only.

method.name: bake
method.description: Rebuilds the index from the static bodies as they are now.

method.name: get_unknown_count
method.description: Number of shapes left out of the index, whose regions the grid does not answer for.

method.name: is_baked
method.description: Whether the index has been built.

members.member: Physics layers whose static bodies are baked.
